notes: Refined dependencies and integration points; no new stories created.

change_log.value: Implement mechanism to automatically trigger manifest regeneration when freshness validation fails prior to pipeline or Brain execution, leveraging existing dev_pipeline orchestration hooks.
Expose internal interface or endpoint to report manifest freshness status (fresh/stale, age, last_generated, hash_status) for use by Brain runner and DevOps pipelines.
Create unit and integration tests validating freshness checks, stale detection, hash drift detection, auto-regeneration trigger, and correct behavior within pipeline and Brain execution flows.

stories.title: Manifest Snapshot Metadata Schema
stories.description: Define schema for manifest snapshot metadata including generated_at timestamp, source_hashes, build_id, and freshness TTL contract to determine validity before execution.

stories.title: Snapshot Freshness Validation Engine
stories.description: Implement core logic to validate manifest freshness by comparing generated_at against TTL and verifying no source file hash drift since snapshot creation.

stories.title: Auto-Regeneration Trigger on Stale Manifest
stories.description: Implement mechanism to automatically trigger manifest regeneration when freshness validation fails prior to pipeline or Brain execution, leveraging existing dev_pipeline orchestration hooks.

stories.title: Manifest Freshness Exposure API
stories.description: Expose internal interface or endpoint to report manifest freshness status (fresh/stale, age, last_generated, hash_status) for use by Brain runner and DevOps pipelines.

stories.title: Manifest Freshness Tests and Integration
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating freshness checks, stale detection, hash drift detection, auto-regeneration trigger, and correct behavior within pipeline and Brain execution flows.
